newsitem.title: USA: Cable TV grabs more viewers from networks - group.
newsitem.headline: Cable TV grabs more viewers from networks - group.

text.p: Basic cable television channels captured more total primetime audience from the three major broadcast networks for the week ended July 6 versus a year ago, according to an analysis by the Cabletelevision Advertising Bureau.
The trade group said that basic cable added 2.37 million households to total 18.5 million, gained 2.3 rating points to 19.1, and added 4.1 percent in share to 39.3 percent.

According to the group, Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS, General Electric Co's NBC, and Walt Disney Co's ABC together lost 1.34 million viewers to a total of 18.22 million households, lost 1.8 points to 18.7 in ratings and shed 4.1 percent for 38.6 share, the group said.
